title: Amendment decision
description: Structured output of an amendment's author (`decideAmendment`, PS-22b): the Chancellor for a quest it drafted, the mage of the plan for one of its sub-quests, passed to Claude Code with --json-schema. The CLI holds an acceptance against kingdom.delegation (its matters in `ask`, the quest's rank): within it, one decide_amendment command rewrites the description, closes the memo and lets the quest go on; beyond it, or with decision owner, the amendment waits for the owner as a question, with this note.
$comment: Generated by `pnpm schemas` from the zod source in packages/domain/src/schema (ADR 0003): change the zod source, never this file. Not expressible here, checked by zod: description is present exactly when decision = accepted.

decision.description: accepted: the amendment is right; `description` is the quest's description rewritten. rejected: the description stands. owner: only the owner can decide (it changes what the owner asked for, a party's contract, or another of the owner's matters in `ask`).

note.description: Why, in the owner's language: the doer's next session reads it as the answer to its amendment, the owner in the digest.

description.description: accepted: the quest's whole description as it should read now, in the quest template; the judge reads it, never the memo.

ask.description: The matters of the owner the amendment touches, whatever the decision: a recorded decision or what the owner asked for changes, a data contract or a party contract changes, it spends more mana than its rank, it acts outside the machine, it touches protected paths. Empty when none.

examples.note: Đúng: mọi bảng định dạng giờ ở `apps/cli/src/listing.ts`; sửa ở đó thì `memo list` cũng đúng giờ.
examples.description:
## Goal

Mọi bảng của CLI in giờ theo múi giờ của vương quốc.

## Steps

1. Sửa `formatTime` trong `apps/cli/src/listing.ts` cho nhận múi giờ của vương quốc.
2. Thêm test cho `quest list` và `memo list` trong `apps/cli/src/listing.spec.ts`.

## Files

- `apps/cli/src/listing.ts`, `apps/cli/src/listing.spec.ts`

## Done when

- `pnpm --filter @elvaria/cli test` xanh.

## Do not touch

- None.

## Known traps

- None known.

examples.note: Kế hoạch đã chọn sửa tay `package.json`: lint của lãnh thổ cho phép, `pnpm lint` chỉ chặn file trong `docs/schemas/`.
Thư đổi điều chủ nhân yêu cầu: bỏ định dạng giờ cũ của `memo list` mà chủ nhân dặn giữ.
